title: Europa League top scorers 2000/01 to 2009/10
brief: Name the top scorer (or a joint top scorer) in the UEFA Cup or Europa League each season from 2000/01 to 2009/10.
period: UEFA Cup and Europa League seasons 2000/01 to 2009/10, main competition only

rows.name: Marcin Kuzba
rows.val: 6 goals, shared: Marcin Kuzba (Lausanne-Sport), Goran Drulic (Red Star Belgrade), Javi Moreno (Alaves), Demis Nikolaidis (AEK Athens)

rows.name: Sonny Anderson
rows.val: 6 goals, shared: Sonny Anderson (Villarreal), Mateja Kezman (PSV), Didier Drogba (Marseille), Alan Shearer (Newcastle)

rows.name: Luca Toni
rows.val: 10 goals, shared: Luca Toni (Bayern Munich), Pavel Pogrebnyak (Zenit)

rows.name: Claudio Pizarro
rows.val: 9 goals, shared: Claudio Pizarro (Werder Bremen), Oscar Cardozo (Benfica)

notes.Henrik Larsson: Henrik Larsson scored 11 in 2002/03, one behind Derlei.
notes.Sonny Anderson: Sonny Anderson shares 2003/04 on 6 goals (UEFA.com now gives him 7).

checks: Each season's top scorer from UEFA.com's season goal rankings (main competition only: first round onwards to 2008/09, group or league stage onwards from 2009/10, qualifying and play-offs left out), checked against Transfermarkt's season scorer lists; they agree on every season except 2003/04, where UEFA.com now credits Sonny Anderson with 7 goals but Transfermarkt and Wikipedia's 2003/04 UEFA Cup article (which cites UEFA's own match protocols) give Anderson, Kezman, Drogba and Shearer 6 each; all four are accepted for that season. Ties are shared rows (alts). Most slots for one player: Alan Shearer 2, so the 4-slot rule passes.
